title: The Coins in the Basin
notes: Reached only with the torch actually on the basin. Two of the coins are not coins. Taking them is undoing what somebody did to a face; leaving them is letting it stand. Terminal either way for the run.

regions.title: The fountain, with the light on it

lines.text: The torch finds the bottom of the fountain. Coins, a lot of them, gone green and flat under the falling water.
People wishing on a building that shut.
Two of them are not lying flat.

choices.text: look closer at the two that are not flat

lines.text: They are domed. Marble, not metal, and cut across the front the way an iris is cut.
Somebody took them out of a face and carried them across the yard and put them in the water.
The falls keep going over them. They have been under this for a while.

choices.text: take them out of the water
put them back where they were

lines.text: Colder than the water. They sit in the palm like two wet pebbles and they do not look like anything at all out of the light.
Whoever did this did not throw them. They put them down.
The silt takes them back over. The falls keep going, and the coins go on being coins.
Not mine. Somebody wanted them down there.
